title: JANUS Genesis Sovereign v6.4 — Portable Local Control, Persistent Client Request Identity, Attested Origin Lineage, Authorization-Bound Provider Evidence, and Failure-Preserving Audit
problem: The v6.3 audit revealed that a green same-host Linux path was insufficient evidence for portability, full session lifecycle serialization, generic client retry identity, lineage authenticity, and external-provider evidence authenticity. v6.4 deliberately attacked those weak boundaries. The first Windows run exposed a real SQLite connection-lifetime defect; that failure is preserved and a descendant correction was verified by a new run rather than retroactively relabeling the failed run.

A1_windows_legacy_chain.finding: Legacy v18.7.25/v18.7.27 still import POSIX fcntl directly, so the full historical controlled runtime chain is not yet established as native-Windows portable.
A1_windows_legacy_chain.v6_4_response: Added janus_portable_lock.py and verified the new portable descendants on Ubuntu and Windows.

A2_session_lifecycle.finding: v6.3 serialized process_turn but not every session-store mutator.
A2_session_lifecycle.v6_4_response: LifecycleSerializedGateway composes one lock domain around register, independent-register, turn, close, and protected reads.

A3_cross_process_evidence.finding: The original gateway concurrency test used threads rather than distinct processes.
A3_cross_process_evidence.v6_4_response: PortableProcessLock now has a spawned-process contention test on both supported CI operating systems.

A4_default_cli_request_identity.finding: play_genesis.py still calls canonical world actions directly and does not use the persistent client request ledger.
A4_default_cli_request_identity.v6_4_response: PersistentClientRequestLedger and controlled client executors were integrated with the real v18.7.26 RuntimeControlAdapter on Linux.

A5_lineage_root_self_assertion.finding: Counting lineage roots instead of face IDs is insufficient if lineage_root is caller-supplied text.
A5_lineage_root_self_assertion.v6_4_response: Reference HMAC lineage attestations bind issuer, face, root, parent, and attestation ID; candidate attestations are verified before review seating.

A6_provider_authority_assertion.finding: An adapter boolean cannot by itself authenticate an external provider-world outcome.
A6_provider_authority_assertion.v6_4_response: Reference signed provider evidence binds provider/effect/idempotency/outcome/evidence/receipt/key and a later hardening descendant also binds authorization_id.

A7_provider_preflight.finding: The older reconciler performed lookup before checking provider identity.
A7_provider_preflight.v6_4_response: The new verified reconciler rejects adapter provider mismatch before any lookup call.

A8_origin_lineage_not_attested.finding: Candidate attestations were insufficient while origin_lineage_root remained caller text.
A8_origin_lineage_not_attested.v6_4_response: AttestedOriginLineageReviewPlanner verifies the origin through the same attestation boundary, then excludes reviewers by the verified origin root.

A9_provider_authorization_not_bound.finding: Signed provider evidence without authorization_id can become stale across reauthorization.
A9_provider_authorization_not_bound.v6_4_response: Authorization-bound provider evidence signs and structurally checks authorization_id; stale evidence from an older authorization is rejected.

A10_settled_client_reexecution.finding: A generic client executor could re-enter its runtime even when the client ledger already said SETTLED.
A10_settled_client_reexecution.v6_4_response: FailClosedSettledClientExecutor refuses generic reexecution of a fully settled caller request.

A11_settlement_result_drift.finding: A repeated settlement could overwrite result_sha256 under one caller request identity.
A11_settlement_result_drift.v6_4_response: ImmutableSettlementClientRequestLedger treats first settlement as immutable; same result hash may be reaffirmed, a different result hash fails closed.

A12_key_lifecycle.finding: Reference HMAC attestation/provider evidence has no production rotation, expiry, or revocation model.
A12_key_lifecycle.v6_4_response: Explicitly retained as an open claim boundary.

micromanagement_learning.lineage: The review system now learns that independence is not only LINEAGE_ROOT rather than FACE_ID; the origin's own lineage claim must cross the same evidence boundary. Otherwise the origin can move the coordinate system and manufacture apparent independence.
micromanagement_learning.provider: External evidence cannot merely name the correct effect. It must be bound to the current authorization lineage so yesterday's valid NO_EFFECT statement cannot silently govern today's authorization.
micromanagement_learning.client_request: Stable request identity and immutable settlement are different layers. The first says which intent is being retried; the second prevents outcome drift after completion.
micromanagement_learning.portability: A cross-platform gate found a resource-lifetime defect that Linux tolerated. Platform diversity is therefore an adversarial verifier, not cosmetic compatibility work.
micromanagement_learning.failure_memory: The failed Windows run remains part of the learning lineage and is explicitly referenced by the successful descendants.
